text: Before becoming an army quartermaster near {Place}, {Name} worked as a warehouse clerk. When the army needed more transport, the quartermaster confiscated civilian carts and sent them to military supply depots.
self_review: A warehouse clerk became an army quartermaster and confiscated civilian carts for military transport.
source_pattern: The supplied Taylor judgments support a pattern in which procurement and administrative experience contributes to later military and political power.
fictional_changes: The clerk-to-quartermaster career and seizure of carts are fictional. They are not acts attributed to Taylor by this card.
